t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I cant remember the specific colours but gnomes with big hats are typically good and those with smaller are hit and miss however ultimately they think it is down to luck as some give 0 but also give big amounts

vb_textbox.text: The coloured gnomes always appear in the same pair. For example I only recieved brown gnomes paired with yellow gnomes, red gnomes paired with orange gnomes. Best stratergy is to just trial each gnome a couple of times and then stick with the one out of the pair that seems to give the most. Must do a couple of times as its kind of random as in a good gnome may sometimes give few mushrooms but over the long run, one gnome of the two will yield more.
